title: Residential as-built plumbing · P-1
method: Prepared manual reference; not detector output. Two-click calibration required in the app.
coverage: Count fixtures once using below-slab tags; measure visible in-building cold/hot and sanitary centerlines. Exclude gas, footing/storm drainage, off-sheet connections, vertical lengths, fittings and unshown appliance branches.
rights: Original third-party sheet retained with its title block. Public accessibility does not establish a redistribution license. Included for this local worked example; confirm rights before public deployment.
